**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Christabel](../persons.html#329)
I think you should poke up [Strahan](../persons.html#1278), though I fancy he is very tiresome about MSS. [^2] I hope you have a copy – [Goosedom](../others.html#104) is very poor this time, all the best being busy or going travelling [Frog](../persons.html#822) is gone to Ammergau[^3]
your affectionate
Mother Goose

[^1]: Endorsed \'Envelope shows 1871\'.

[^2]: Probably this refers to some attempt by Coleridge to publish fiction in [Good Words](../others.html#73), the magazine published by Alexander Strahan.

[^3]: The decennial performance of the Passion Play in the Bavarian village of Oberammergau had become a popular tourist attraction.

The 1870 performance was interrupted by the outbreak of the Franco-Prussian War, and was resumed in June 1871 (Pall Mall Gazette 9 June 1871).
